title: Why You Keep Failing Tight Motorcycle U-Turns
hook: Stop looking down during sharp turns.

script.narration: Stop looking down during sharp turns.
script.visual_search: motorcycle rider turning on a curved road

script.narration: Your motorcycle naturally goes wherever your eyes point. If you stare at the pavement right in front of your front tire, your brain locks your steering and you drop the bike. Instead, turn your chin completely toward where you want to exit.
